payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into the criteria used by raters to evaluate classifier outputs, specifically focusing on the appropriateness of predicted error types.

claims.text: Raters selected 'Bad' when the chosen error type was not appropriate for the edit, while 'Good' indicated the most appropriate type.
Raters selected 'Acceptable' when the error type was appropriate but not the optimum choice for the edit.
The evaluation was subjective, with raters focusing on the appropriateness of error types despite potentially unusual edit boundaries.
